info.title: HOTEL PMS SAAS - Phase 9 implemented operations
info.description: Operations implemented in Phase 9 packages P09-01..P09-03. P09-01: housekeeping tasks once per confirmed stay event with assignment/start/complete/inspection, facility inspection policy and long-stay interval, DND logging. P09-02: work orders with the Open..Closed lifecycle and documented reopening, OOO/OOS recomputed from open orders only, emergency blocks with disruptions independent from closure. P09-03: the operations board (tasks/DND/notifications snapshot), shift handover that records counts and an optional cashier-session reference without replacing the cashier ledger, and internal notifications that never leave the system.

Error.description: Fixed error code, localized message key, correlation id and bounded details without secrets

get.description: Task board data for one property; task views never include guest identity or money.

200.description: Scoped task list ordered by creation with a safe cursor

post.description: Housekeeping tasks tied to a reservation item follow the versioned facility long-stay schedule; repeat inside the interval is rejected. MAINTENANCE tasks are created through work orders (P09-02).
Assign or reassign an active task; reassignment during IN_PROGRESS keeps the task visible and the resource CLEANING.
The assigned member starts cleaning; the room moves to CLEANING and readiness is not granted.
The assigned member reports cleaning done; the room becomes CLEAN. When the facility policy requires inspection, CLEAN alone does not make the room deliverable.
Supervisor inspection from CLEAN to INSPECTED; self-inspection is denied when the facility policy requires inspection.

get.description: DND/service-refusal log for one property; logging never flips housekeeping state.

post.description: Records a DND/service refusal with time and optional follow-up; housekeeping state is untouched.
Records the follow-up attempt on an ACTIVE DND entry once.

get.description: Facility operations policy: inspection requirement and long-stay cleaning interval with its version.

put.description: Creates or updates the versioned facility policy; updates require the current version.

get.description: Work orders for one property with their resource impact and lifecycle state.

post.description: Opens a work order. Impact OOO/OOS blocks delivery through maintenance state; emergency requires an OOO impact, a period and maintenance.emergency, and creates an emergency block with disruption records without touching any reservation.
Assigns or reassigns an open work order to an active member; reassignment during IN_PROGRESS keeps the current state.
Moves the work order along Open to Verified with a resolution note required at RESOLVED; CLOSED has its own operation.
Closes a verified work order; maintenance state is recomputed from the remaining open orders only and any independent block stays ACTIVE.
Reopens a closed work order with a documented reason; the impact applies again but never overrides a newer open reason.

get.description: Task/DND/notification snapshot for the current property business date; task views never include guest identity or money.
Latest shift handovers with their recorded counts and cashier-session reference.

post.description: Records open tasks/work orders/DND counts and an optional cashier-session snapshot; it is an operational log and never replaces the cashier ledger.

get.description: Internal operations notifications visible to the actor (property-wide or addressed) with per-member read receipts; nothing is sent to any external adapter.

post.description: Records the actor read receipt; a notification addressed to another member stays out of reach.
